summary: Implementation plan for Xiaomi/iOS-style expanded 2x2 Home Screen folders (supporting both 2x2 Bento and 3x3 Dense layouts), direct app launch with mini-grid folder expansion, 5-column label-free Home Screen layout matching the reference screenshot, and real-time hold-and-swipe drag-and-drop with free placement, position swapping, and drop-to-merge folder creation.
